pairs.subject: live-test-consent-and-evidence
pairs.evidence: apps/stage/src/App.tsx:386 The on-air source pill (stage-kit TopBar, drawn in the OBS broadcast view) is chosen from the URL mode `const live = params.run !== null` (App.tsx:69), not from state: the daemon replays a finished run from disk on the same `?run=<id>` subscribe (events.rs:302), so a stored replay of a simulated run (viewers with platform "sim") is stamped LIVE, and there is no simulated or unknown word for it.

techniques.evidence: apps/stage/src/App.tsx:386 The label comes from the session mode (params.run, App.tsx:69 `const live = params.run !== null;`). There are only two hard-coded words, with no 'simulated' and no 'unknown'. Stage.tsx/TopBar take the label as a free `sourceTag: string` the caller passes in. That is exactly the 'a mode is not state' and 'no caller passes a label in' failure.

apps/stage/src/source.ts:8 The stage's only network peer is the team's own local daemon WebSocket, and connectDaemon takes an injectable socket for tests. No stage test reaches a streaming platform, and the technique excludes calls to the team's own services.
apps/stage/scripts/make-demo.mjs:45 Every viewer in the stage fixtures is generated with platform "sim". No test here acts on a real account or channel.

pairs.subject: live-test-consent-and-evidence
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/events.rs:13 The /events wire frame (`{seq, run_id, event}`) is deliberately identical for a run in flight and a run replayed from disk (events.rs:302 `otherwise replay from disk`), and a simulated sim.start run is published under the name "live". No consumer can derive live / replayed / simulated from state, which is why the stage labels by URL mode.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/events.rs:13 The state that would decide the label (in-flight LiveRun vs disk replay, sim source) never reaches the frame as a typed field. The technique holds that provenance belongs as a typed field on the state; without it every consumer has to infer it from its own mode.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/e2e/mod.rs:1 This context's e2e and CLI tests are hermetic (scripted engine on loopback). None of them calls twitch.connect or any platform endpoint, so there is no live test to gate.

pairs.registryProposal: The subject frames 'live' as observed on the real streaming platform, but repos like this one use 'live' for an in-flight local simulation (`subscribe: "live"`, `Live sim.start runs`). The provenance-labels technique could add a rule that internal transport names ('live' = in flight) must not leak into viewer-facing labels without the platform/simulated axis being derived separately.
